claim: No OpenDRI project had built a self-sustaining revenue stream; all remained funded through pilot or scaling funding.
stance_target: open disaster-data platforms face a sustainability gap
scope_conditions: OpenDRI draft guide, undated early sketch
quoted_support: All current projects remain funded through their pilot or scaling funding plans. None have built self-sustaining revenue streams.

claim: Without continuous funding, risk data goes stale and communities revert to older methods.
quoted_support: Without continuous funding, communities of practice often fall back to using familiar, older methods; thought leaders move onto the next problem

claim: Academic partnerships (GIS in university curricula) and Living Labs are proposed sustainability mechanisms; immediate use-case usefulness is the key success attribute.
quoted_support: building GIS into curricula or creating training programs in local universities has proven an effective mechanism for instilling risk thinking
